bullets.text: VMO2 Eyes Netomnia Takeover - **VMO2** is negotiating a £2 billion acquisition of **Netomnia**, marking a significant UK altnet consolidation.
ACOME Tackles Sustainability - **ACOME** highlights the challenge of balancing sustainability ambitions with cost pressures in telecoms.
Starlink Gains Spectrum Boost - **Ofcom** grants **Starlink** additional spectrum to enhance backhaul capacity amid rising demand.
Nvidia Backs Nokia for 6G - **Nvidia** invests in **Nokia** to advance enterprise edge AI and 6G capabilities in radio networks.
Equinix Invests in Data Centres - **Equinix** plans a £3.9 billion data centre in Hertfordshire, boosting UK digital infrastructure.
O2 Partners with Starlink - **O2** collaborates with **Starlink** to enhance enterprise connectivity in rural areas.
Telecoms Embrace AI Cloud - Telecom operators are rapidly shifting to cloud solutions to leverage AI for operational efficiency.
OneLayer Secures £28m for 5G - **OneLayer** raises $28 million to enhance security in private 5G networks across industries.
AI-Native 6G Networks Emerge - AI integration in **6G** networks promises to revolutionize enterprise operations and user experiences.
